name: mishap_list
label: Every mishap
description: One row per kept mishap: what happened, its cost, its low-mid-high price range and how it was priced. The page sorts it for the top 10 disasters and picks out the rows behind a season or loss type (dbt does not support order_by or limit on saved queries yet).

metrics.name: total_mishap_loss
metrics.label: Total Mishap Loss
metrics.description: Every kept mishap, realized + hypothetical + catastrophic. Hypothetical losses always count; loss_kind is only a slice.

metrics.name: total_mishap_loss_low
metrics.label: Total Mishap Loss (low)
metrics.description: Low end of the total's range. Stated prices count at their price.

metrics.name: total_mishap_loss_high
metrics.label: Total Mishap Loss (high)
metrics.description: High end of the total's range. Stated prices count at their price.
